results.name: embed control (SM-04): YouTube handshake with origin + id, Play/Pause commands, progress clock, ended → auto-next by loadVideoById in the SAME player; spoofed 'ended' from our own window or a foreign-origin frame is ignored; Auto-next off stops

embed control (SM-04): Vimeo ready → addEventListener subscriptions → ended advances to the next item (new player, autoplay requested); SoundCloud ready → subscriptions → playProgress clock → finish advances (auto_play=true); Spotify (TT29): ready → ack, Play → confirmed toggle, clock, a near-end pause is NOT an end, paused-at-end → inferred end → next Spotify player asked to play

offline gazetteer (MP-04/MP-05): API answers 'Paris, TX' and 'In Raleigh' with attribution; Maps search lists cities, flies there, 'Save as place' writes it; new places are named by the nearest city; hover says how far from which city; zero third-party requests

in-app ask dialog (SH-15) replaces prompt(): focus lands in the field with the default selected; Tab is trapped; global shortcuts are blocked while it is open (modal); Enter creates, Escape cancels and focus returns to the opener; passphrases are masked, double-entered and validated in place

Business Snap (LY-16/LY-17): hovering Maximise opens the layouts flyout; a quarter zone places the window exactly; Snap Assist offers the other windows for the remaining zones in order; a title-bar drag into a corner shows a live preview and snaps to that quarter; the Snap layouts chord opens the flyout with keyboard focus

Art dock (LY-18/LY-19): auto-hide slides the dock off-screen and gives windows the space; the bottom edge reveals it; it stays ≥ 400 ms after leaving and hides by ~600 ms; keyboard focus reveals it; minimise plays the genie into the dock tile (clip-path funnel), and not at all under reduced motion

accessibility tree (AX-13): Playwright ariaSnapshot of the live page in Fusion, Business and Art: landmarks and names a screen reader would announce (dock / taskbar navigation, named window dialogs, no unnamed buttons or text fields); the ask dialog and the snap flyout expose their roles and names
